text:
maria_p: quick sync — we need to finalize preflight for Snowflake -> VectorDB delta ingest sample set. Can we validate schema and sample retention strategy before marketplace listing?

kevin_t: timeline?

maria_p: hoping to run tests this week. Need infra slot and hardware partner validation. @oliver_g can you verify streaming connector handles schema drift?

oliver_g: yep, will run a smoke pass tonight. what's the sample size? 10k rows?

maria_p: 5k initial, 50k if first pass ok. keep nulls and nested objects.

anya_r: note: Databricks parquet export has nested map fields — our qdrant loader choked last time. adding a transform to flatten maps. example:

```
# sample transform snippet
df = spark.read.parquet('s3://redwood-samples/delta/')
df = df.withColumn('attrs', to_json(col('attrs')))
df.write.json('/tmp/flat')
```

kevin_t: also add unit to redwood-optimize: quantization check for embeddings fallback.

julia_s: partners-bot posted a checklist link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/partners/ddb-ingest-preflight

maria_p: thanks. quick decisions: who owns marketplace listing metadata? kevin_t?

kevin_t: I can own the listing metadata. I'll pull sample meta from the test run and draft description.

oliver_g: dev infra needs an onboarded dataset and a hardware-run slot — @anya_r can you schedule with hw-team?

anya_r: will ping hw-team and databricks; aiming Thu 10am PT. :calendar: 

maria_p: ok assignables: oliver validate loader, anya schedule hw + transform, kevin draft listing + upload sample. i'll run acceptance and update runbook.

kevin_t: added checklist items in the confluence. marked as in-progress.

maria_p: any blockers?

oliver_g: only minor — need new credentials for qdrant test cluster. I'll ask infra.

maria_p: great. if all green we aim to promote connector to marketplace sandbox Mon. :rocket: 

julia_s: FYI legal wants data residency note for EU pilots.

maria_p: noted. will add residency note to listing.

kevin_t: ETA for first smoke results: tomorrow EOD.

maria_p: perfect. thanks team. :thumbsup:
